title: The signs of all Ehrhart coefficients for face lattices of polygons
description: Lean 4 proofs, a manuscript and exact certificates for the signs of every ordinary Ehrhart coefficient of order polytopes of polygon face lattices. For an n-gon the number of negative coefficients is max(n-12,0). The October 2026 thirteen-gon witness is credited in the paper. The Apache license covers the original source code and verification scripts. The manuscript is distributed with its separate copyright notice.
